projects.title: Things I've built
projects.subtitle: Six React and Next.js applications, each solving a real UI, performance or state-management problem. Open a case study for the full breakdown.

items.name: ApexCart
items.subtitle: Next.js e-commerce storefront
items.description: A Next.js storefront with a virtualised product catalog, optimistic cart updates and Stripe checkout — smooth on mid-tier phones.
items.imageAlt: ApexCart storefront showing a virtualised product catalog grid
items.challenge: Keeping a large product catalog scrolling at 60fps on low-end devices, without re-rendering the whole page on every cart update.
items.solution: Built a virtualised product grid in React, moved global state from Redux to Zustand with fine-grained selectors so only the cart badge re-renders, and added optimistic UI updates with a retry queue for flaky connections.
items.outcome: Smooth catalog scrolling on mid-tier Android, and add-to-cart that feels instant even on a slow network.
items.techStack: Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Zustand, Tailwind CSS, Stripe API, SWR

items.name: SyncMed
items.subtitle: Real-time appointment booking app
items.description: A React booking app with live slot availability, background data refetching and offline draft recovery for half-filled forms.
items.imageAlt: SyncMed scheduling portal showing a timeline of doctor availability slots
items.challenge: Two users grabbing the same popular slot at once — while keeping the UI responsive offline and free of layout shift as availability updates stream in.
items.solution: Set up a polling and caching layer with TanStack Query v5, persisted in-progress form drafts to IndexedDB, and handled booking conflicts at the API boundary with clear inline error states.
items.outcome: Contested slots resolve to a single confirmed booking, and a dropped connection no longer wipes the patient's form.
items.techStack: React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, IndexedDB, Context API, Framer Motion, Axios

items.name: VigilantFinance
items.subtitle: Invoice & analytics dashboard
items.description: A data-dense React dashboard with interactive charts, fast client-side filtering and shareable, URL-synced views.
items.imageAlt: VigilantFinance dashboard showing financial charts and invoice analytics
items.challenge: Rendering large invoice datasets across several live charts without freezing the UI every time a filter changed.
items.solution: Memoised aggregation into reactive selectors, virtualised the data table, and synced every filter to URL query params so any view can be copied and shared.
items.outcome: Users can slice the data and paste the exact view to a colleague — no re-filtering, no dropped frames.
items.techStack: React, TypeScript, Recharts, CSS Modules, Vite

items.name: SecureX Gate
items.subtitle: Authentication & session UI
items.description: A production-ready login flow with secure token handling, silent session refresh and protected React routes.
items.imageAlt: SecureX Gate authentication screen with email and password fields
items.challenge: Keeping auth tokens out of reach of XSS while still refreshing sessions seamlessly across every open tab.
items.solution: Routed auth calls through a lightweight proxy so tokens live in HttpOnly cookies instead of localStorage, guarded routes with a typed React auth context, and used BroadcastChannel to sync session state between tabs.
items.outcome: No token is ever exposed to JavaScript, and signing out in one tab signs out everywhere instantly.
items.techStack: React, TypeScript, HttpOnly cookies, React Router guards, BroadcastChannel

items.name: TaskFlow Core
items.subtitle: Drag-and-drop task board
items.description: A Kanban-style React board with drag-and-drop, custom hooks for board state, and full keyboard and screen-reader support.
items.imageAlt: TaskFlow Core board showing draggable task cards arranged in columns
items.challenge: Making a drag-and-drop board that is genuinely usable with a keyboard and a screen reader, not just a mouse.
items.solution: Extracted board logic into reusable custom hooks with a clear set of valid transitions, and built the interactions on react-aria primitives so every drag has a keyboard equivalent with live region announcements.
items.outcome: The entire board can be reordered without ever touching a pointing device.
items.techStack: React, TypeScript, custom hooks, react-aria, Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules

items.name: SearchEase Core
items.subtitle: Instant search UI
items.description: Type-ahead search over thousands of records with sub-millisecond lookups and animated result transitions.
items.imageAlt: SearchEase interface showing an animated filtered result list
items.challenge: Filtering thousands of records on every keystroke without dropping animation frames or lagging the input.
items.solution: Built a client-side prefix index for instant matching and drove the result list with Framer Motion layout animations, which stay on hardware-accelerated transforms.
items.outcome: Results reorder in real time as you type, with no perceptible input lag.
